Guides.title: Guides
Guides.intro: The applied protocols, built on the research we publish in full.
Guides.researchFree: The evidence stays free. What you pay for is the protocol built on top of it, never the studies themselves.
Guides.delivery: PDF, downloadable straight after payment from your account.
Guides.researchBody: Every claim in this guide traces back to our own analysis of the published studies, including the ones that found nothing. Read it first, free, and only buy this if it earns it.
Guides.noticeBody: These guides are written for optimising a healthy body, and they are not medical advice. Nothing here diagnoses or treats a condition. Always talk to your doctor, physiotherapist or another qualified professional first, and especially if you have a diagnosed condition, are in pain, are pregnant, or take medication. If a guide reaches the edge of what it can responsibly say, it says so and refers you on.

About.title: Our mission
About.lead: Nice to meet you. Kratos Natural is the shop and research arm of Liam Kratos, orthomolecular therapist and longevity coach.
About.body1: We sell natural products, and we publish the research behind them. Not press releases, not marketing claims: systematic reviews and meta-analyses, read in full and reported with the numbers intact.
About.body2: If we cannot trace a claim to an indexed, published source, we do not make it. Every analysis lists its PMIDs so you can check the work yourself.
About.slide1Body: Slow your aging process with methods that have been tested.
About.slide2Body: Learn about longevity and anti-aging from A to Z.
About.slide3Body: Visit the shop for natural products of the highest quality.
About.planBody: The whole argument, written out: what is wrong with how food and attention are built, why it can change now, and what we are building over the next ten years.
About.slide1Alt: A young man looking into a mirror that reflects him as an old man, with a glowing DNA helix between them
About.slide2Alt: Open-air campus of timber buildings with thatched roofs, students walking the paths between them
About.slide3Alt: Covered fresh food market, stalls piled with unpackaged fruit, vegetables and mushrooms
